summary: Iteration 21 both-side regression completed. Backend APIs for subscriber create/legacy-plan/manual-expiry and super-admin bulk import passed, and mobile-first UI flows validated on public preview with role checks, active-plan upgrade navigation, bulk-import behavior, AI support card, and 390x844 responsive sanity.
action_items: Optional hardening: expose explicit disabled/accessibility state for malformed bulk-import submit button on web to avoid force-click ambiguity in automation.
Optional config alignment: frontend/src/api.ts reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL; ensure this stays aligned with deployment env naming policy.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/api.ts currently resolves backend URL from expoConfig.extra.backendUrl or EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL; this differs from strict EXPO_BACKEND_URL-only policy in platform guidance.
Bulk import malformed rows are functionally blocked (row errors shown, no result produced) even when automation force-clicks submit.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ITER21 subscribers/plans and two UI bulk users (8791100111, 8791100112); cleaned up after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth testing used short-lived locally generated JWTs from JWT_SECRET + exact DB user IDs (no OTP). Public preview URL used. WhatsBoost remained MOCKED/untouched and no live provider HTTP calls were made.
rca_of_issue: Initial pytest failure was test-data RCA only: generated phone values accidentally used hex characters, violating backend phone validator. Fixed test generator to numeric-only 10-digit phones; rerun passed fully.
